$comment: Rencana rate limit SnapBox, PRD Bab 8.2 (baris 816-822). DRAFT review-only: TIDAK ada yang dieksekusi terhadap Cloudflare. Bentuk skema mengikuti Rulesets API Cloudflare pada phase http_ratelimit: satu ruleset berisi array rules, tiap rule punya ratelimit.characteristics (menerima ip.src, cf.colo.id, atau kunci header berbentuk http.request.headers["nama-header"]), period detik, requests_per_period, mitigation_timeout detik, dan requests_to_origin boolean. Hanya ip.src yang tersedia tanpa bantuan: karakteristik email, device fingerprint, booth, dan tenant berasal dari body/identitas internal sehingga butuh Transform Rule atau Worker yang menyalinnya ke header sesuai penanda $requiresTransform / $requiresWorker dan PRD Bab 10.5.

rules.name: webhook-gateway-300-per-min-per-ip
rules.$comment: PRD Bab 8.2: /api/webhooks/* 300 req/min per IP (allowlist gateway IP). Allowlist gateway ditegakkan aturan terpisah di waf-custom-rules.json, bukan oleh ratelimit; ratelimit ini hanya plafon per IP.

rules.name: auth-10-per-min-per-ip
rules.$comment: PRD Bab 8.2: /api/auth/* 10 req/min per IP. Pasangan dari auth-5-per-min-per-email.

rules.name: auth-5-per-min-per-email
rules.$comment: PRD Bab 8.2: /api/auth/* 5 req/min per email. Email ada di body request, bukan header, sehingga ekspresi mencocokkan header http.request.headers["x-auth-email"] yang harus disuntik oleh Transform Rule (http_request_transform). Tanpa Transform Rule aturan ini tidak akan pernah cocok.

rules.name: booth-60-per-min-per-device-fingerprint
rules.$comment: PRD Bab 8.2: /api/booth/* 60 req/min per device fingerprint. Header x-device-fingerprint disuntik Worker; identitas per device+tenant (jangan hanya IP karena NAT) mengikuti PRD 8.4 dan PRD Bab 10.5.

rules.name: payment-create-30-per-min-per-booth
rules.$comment: PRD Bab 8.2: /api/payment/create 30 req/min per booth. Header x-booth-id disuntik Worker (PRD Bab 10.5).

rules.name: contact-5-per-hour-per-ip
rules.$comment: PRD Bab 8.2: /api/contact 5 req/jam per IP. period dan mitigation_timeout satu jam (3600 detik).

rules.name: operator-20-per-min-per-booth
rules.$comment: PRD Bab 8.2: /api/operator/* 20 req/min per booth. Header x-booth-id disuntik Worker (PRD Bab 10.5).

rules.name: pairing-10-per-min-per-tenant
rules.$comment: PRD Bab 8.2: /api/pairing/* 10 req/min per tenant. Header x-tenant-id disuntik Worker (PRD Bab 10.5).
